dedupe_keys.name: hysolsim plantwide dynamic simulator for a hybrid solar thermal power plant

description: Dibyajyoti Baidya and colleagues at IIT Bombay and VNIT Nagpur publish HysolSim, a MATLAB simulator for hybrid solar-thermal plants with parabolic-trough collectors and linear Fresnel reflectors. It also runs in trough-only mode. The June 2026 Zenodo release supplies code, inputs, results and documentation under MIT at no cost; MATLAB has separate licensing requirements. The repository documents constant, step-change, cloud-disturbed and observed irradiance profiles, with observed coverage of one summer day in 2014 at Gurgaon, India. Cold and hot startup options cover a two-day simulation. The authors tested MATLAB R2024b, recommend at least 16 GB RAM, and warn that some inputs below 400 W/m² or unsuitable parameter values can produce invalid numerical states. Hot startup needs files generated by a prior cold run. These limitations matter for plantwide dynamic and control simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly includes HysolSim. Claimed results were not reproduced, and the SoftwareX paper is described as submitted.
